description: This file declares the GzipSourceStream class, which handles gzip and deflate content encoding/decoding for data streams, utilizing zlib inflate. It manages various states of processing gzip headers, deflate headers, and stream decoding, and includes mechanisms for inserting zlib headers as a workaround for server bugs.

classes.name: GzipSourceStream
classes.description: A class that applies gzip and deflate decoding to data streams, managing various decoding states and headers.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a GzipSourceStream instance, returning nullptr if initialization fails.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the stream, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns the type of the stream as a string.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Processes input data buffers to decode gzip/deflate content, updating output buffers.

methods.name: InsertZlibHeader
methods.description: Inserts a zlib header into the data stream as a workaround for server bugs.
